verificationNotes: Independent practice starts at0/12. Two actual IOS reference configurations earn ten live goals after real BGP convergence. Actual PC1-to-SRV1 and SRV1-to-PC1 pings complete twelve. Completed documents contain saved configuration and empty runtime without fabricated route/session/traffic achievements.

Uses existing TCP/BGP protocol engine unchanged: delivered TCP179 OPEN and KEEPALIVE, negotiated IPv4 capability and hold180; default single-hop eBGP, no multihop/update-source. Both local origins require the exact connected /24 route. Local weight32768/empty AS path/nextHop0.0.0.0; received eBGP path has singleton peer AS, origin i, peer transit next hop, weight0/localpref100/MED0. Actual outbound UPDATE snapshots contain the local AS prepended.

Distinct checks verify reciprocal intended peers, real established transport, originated networks, received best paths, actual advertised prefixes, installed B routes at AD20/metric0 and healthy saved startup. Forwarding credit correlates source send, both routers' actual forwarding, received frames and parent-linked reply identities.

Network withdrawal sends actual UPDATE and preserves the same TCP channel and establishment time while R1 loses the server route; both host tests fail due missing forward/return reachability. Restoring network recovers advertisements and forwarding. Wrong remote-AS, missing reciprocal peer, TCP179 blocking and shutdown prevent usable BGP; repair reconnects.

Exact-match /25 negative origination and disabled default IPv4 activation plus explicit address-family activation work. Static shortcuts, changed external administrative distance, missing/mismatched packet evidence and unsaved edits cannot satisfy their requested goals.

Offline reopening rebuilds fresh transport and learned routes while retaining earned traffic observations. IOS reload restores saved neighbors. Current configuration/control-plane/route/save goals remain live.

All guide IOS and Windows verification commands were executed, including numeric State/PfxRcd summary, Established detail, BGP prefix and advertised-route views, B RIB routes, running/startup configuration, actual pings and traceroute.
Checked against Cisco primary documentation. This change does not claim a new live CML capture, platform-wide parity, multihop, iBGP, IPv6 BGP or routing-policy coverage.

Existing terminal appearance and layout preserved. Catalog counts and browser assertions updated to eight Layer3 labs and seventeen ENCOR labs. Existing AAA invalid-import test uses a bounded record view to avoid TypeScript union-expression expansion as the lesson criterion union grows; its runtime assertions are unchanged.
